trust_decision.summary: A file path that PHPCS is asked to scan is pasted raw into a shell command string run through popen() at three independent call sites - Gitblame (basename of the path), Hgblame (full path, after chdir to the repo root) and Svnblame (full path, no chdir) - and each of those call sites is where the trust decision is taken; there is no shared escaping helper in VersionControl.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names only the 'gitblame report', so the first place an engineer looks is the command construction in Gitblame::getBlameContent(), where the double-quoted basename is interpolated into 'git blame'.

fix_sites.module_kind: built-in CLI report class (Reports\Gitblame, selected by Config --report=)
built-in CLI report class (Reports\Hgblame, selected by Config --report=)
built-in CLI report class (Reports\Svnblame, selected by Config --report=)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names only the Gitblame report, so the Mercurial and Subversion blame classes read as neighbouring features in other report classes; a solver can further argue that hg/svn blame have no option that executes anything, so escaping the file name at the git site is the whole job.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Hgblame chdir()s to the repository root and then blames the file by its full (absolute) path, and Svnblame never chdir()s at all, so both must keep receiving the path as given; an over-broad fix that copies Gitblame's basename() normalisation onto them breaks blame for every file in a subdirectory. Correct escaping (escapeshellarg) must also keep a path containing spaces arriving as one argument.

O6_input_shapes: file name containing shell metacharacters / command substitution, e.g. '$(touch newfile.txt).php' - closed by escapeshellarg in all three reports
file name beginning with '-' (option/parameter injection) - closed by the end-of-options '--' separator at the git site only
file name containing spaces or quotes - kept as a single argument by escapeshellarg
path shape differs per report: bare basename after chdir(dirname()) for git, full/absolute path after chdir(repo root) for hg, full path with no chdir for svn

O7_producer.where: src/Files/DummyFile.php:42-55 (path taken from a 'phpcs_input_file:' header in the stdin content, or overridden by --stdin-path at src/Config.php:1000-1012, where a failed Common::realpath() keeps the raw string); on the normal path src/Files/LocalFile.php:32 only trims the CLI-supplied path

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fourth VCS blame report class (e.g. Fossil/Bzr/P4) in src/Reports/ written from the same four-line popen() template
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The three blame reports are copy-paste siblings over one abstract VersionControl base class, so a maintainer adding another VCS would clone the unescaped command construction.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new git-backed file filter interpolating its config-derived path without escapeshellarg
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GitModified and GitStaged are the other two places a caller-supplied path reaches a shell command, and they are copy-paste siblings of each other.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new external-linter debug sniff that interpolates the scanned file name into its command
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Six Debug/*Sniff classes wrap external binaries with the same Common::escapeshellcmd + escapeshellarg pattern; a new one copied from an older example is plausible.

O9_family: OS command injection (CWE-78): untrusted file path interpolated unescaped into a shell command string passed to popen()

O10_build.toolchain: PHP >= 5.4 (composer.json:33) with ext-tokenizer, ext-simplexml, ext-xmlwriter; Composer; PHPUnit ^4||^5||^6||^7||^8||^9.3.4 (composer.json:39); no compile step
O10_build.project_tests: PHPUnit suites run through tests/AllTests.php (composer 'test', composer.json:55-58) plus shell End-to-End scripts under tests/EndToEnd/. At the pinned commit there is no tests/Core/Reports directory, so no unit test covers the blame reports; the fix adds tests/Core/Reports/GitBlame/GitblameEscapesFilenameTest.php as a brand-new file. Exercising the affected behaviour needs the git binary and a git working tree, but no network.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add escapeshellarg(basename($filename)) at the Gitblame site only and drop the end-of-options '--', which still lets a file named '-V.php' be parsed by git as an option and leaves Hgblame/Svnblame raw.
